description: This file defines a system for managing and broadcasting node events, including event types, event data structures, an event bus with subscription management, event publishing functions for various node state changes, and mechanisms for filtering duplicate events to prevent spam.

classes.name: NodeEvent
classes.description: Represents a node state change event with fields for type, node ID, status, timestamp, data, and additional fields for unified status system.

classes.name: NodeEventBus
classes.description: Manages subscriptions and broadcasting of node events, including filtering duplicate events and handling subscriber channels.

methods.name: NewNodeEventBus
methods.description: Creates a new instance of NodeEventBus.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber channel to the event bus.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber channel from the event bus.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all subscribers with filtering and error handling.

methods.name: GetSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active subscribers.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Converts a NodeEvent to its JSON string representation.

methods.name: PublishNodeOnline
methods.description: Publishes a node online event.

methods.name: PublishNodeOffline
methods.description: Publishes a node offline event.

methods.name: PublishNodeRegistered
methods.description: Publishes a node registered event.

methods.name: PublishNodeStatusUpdated
methods.description: Publishes a node status update event.

methods.name: PublishNodeHealthChanged
methods.description: Publishes a node health change event.

methods.name: PublishNodeMCPHealthChanged
methods.description: Publishes an MCP health change event.

methods.name: PublishNodeRemoved
methods.description: Publishes a node removed event.

methods.name: PublishNodesRefresh
methods.description: Publishes a general nodes refresh event.

methods.name: PublishNodeHeartbeat
methods.description: Publishes a heartbeat event.

methods.name: StartNodeHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts a goroutine to send periodic heartbeat events.

methods.name: shouldFilterEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event should be filtered to prevent spam, including deduplication logic.

methods.name: isDuplicateStatusEvent
methods.description: Checks if a status event is a duplicate within a short time window.

methods.name: compareStatusEventData
methods.description: Compares two status events to determine if they are effectively the same.

methods.name: cleanupEventCache
methods.description: Removes old entries from the event cache to prevent unbounded growth.

methods.name: PublishNodeUnifiedStatusChanged
methods.description: Publishes a unified node status change event with detailed old/new status info.

methods.name: PublishNodeStateTransition
methods.description: Publishes a node state transition event.

methods.name: PublishNodeStatusRefreshed
methods.description: Publishes a node status refreshed event.

methods.name: PublishBulkStatusUpdate
methods.description: Publishes a bulk update of node statuses.

methods.name: PublishNodeStatusUpdatedEnhanced
methods.description: Publishes an enhanced node status update with backward compatibility.

methods.name: PublishNodeHealthChangedEnhanced
methods.description: Publishes an enhanced node health change event.

methods.name: PublishSystemStateSnapshot
methods.description: Publishes a snapshot of the system state including all agents and reasoners.
